name: docs
label: API documentation (OpenAPI + Swagger UI)
description: An OpenAPI 3.1 document generated from the routes the service actually mounts, served with Swagger UI at /docs and as JSON at /docs/openapi.json.

env.comment: Serve Swagger UI at /docs. Defaults to on outside production.

notes: The document is generated from the mounted routers, the zod schemas passed to validate(), and the action passed to authorize() — nothing is hand-written, so it cannot drift from the code.
Response bodies are described by the shared envelope; per-endpoint response schemas are the natural next step.
